pages.text: Search for large tower in Cyberland, climb to the top and you will find the Gem Cutting Station, Gem Cutting Head and a Piston.

pages.title: Cutting Heads
pages.text: Craft the Gem Cutting Head into a Diamond, Tsavorite or Tourmaile Gem Cutting Head, use a gem on the station, and then use a piston or other pushing device to push the cutting head against the top of the block to cut the gem.
